references.text: Gideon had torn down Baal's altar and cut down the Asherah pole during the night, which led the people to ask who had done this.
The men of the city discovered in the morning that Baal's altar had been torn down and the Asherah pole had been cut down, leading to their investigation.
After the people found out that Gideon had done this, they demanded that Joash hand over his son to be put to death.
The expression 'said to one another' is used when people discuss and investigate an important event together.
A similar situation where religious leaders investigate and ask who has performed a specific action.
